mechanism: Composite-key indicator-handle cache with reference counting and FlushAll cleanup for multi-symbol/multi-TF EAs; no market feature is computed.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Demo: ATR/MA/RSI across configurable symbols and timeframes (e.g. EURUSD H1).
why_new_for_mis: Infrastructure only — handle lifecycle, not sensing.
quote: The lazy-loading resource manager pattern resolves these inefficiencies through three core mechanisms: On-Demand Initialization... Reference Counting... Centralized Ownership

mechanism: IIndicator decorator chain (timing, logging, threshold filter) wrapping RSI/MA GetValue(); software extension pattern, not a market sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart symbol; default PERIOD_H1; RSI(14) and EMA(21).
why_new_for_mis: Design-pattern article; threshold filter is generic value clipping, not a MIS regime/vol/liquidity sensor.
quote: Timing, logging, and filtering are properties of how the indicator is used in a specific context.

mechanism: Daily-reset session VWAP: typical price (H+L+C)/3 weighted by tick_volume from broker midnight; second pass volume-weighted variance → std_dev bands (multiplier input, default 1.5); closed-bar shift=1; mean-reversion touch of lower/upper band with exit at VWAP.
data_needed: CopyRates from GetStartOfDay(midnight) to shift; high/low/close/tick_volume; deviation_multiplier.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Liquid FX pairs; M5 Strategy Tester noted; highest reliability London/NY; daily TF returns false (no intraday history).
why_new_for_mis: Intraday liquidity-anchored fair-value sensor with volume-weighted volatility bands that expand/contract with real session flow — MIS can sense stretch vs institutional VWAP without fixed MA lag.
quote: The Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) fulfills this role by weighting every price fluctuation by the absolute liquidity traded at that level.... volume-weighted standard deviation... naturally expand and contract based on real intraday volatility shifts.

mechanism: Even Better Sinewave: single-pole HP (duration default 40) → Super Smoother → 3-bar Wave/sqrt(Pwr) normalization; oscillates in [-1,+1] in cycle mode; rails near ±1 in trend mode — railing is the cycle-to-trend regime flag.
data_needed: Median price (H+L)/2 bar stream; duration and ssPeriod; Ready() after 3 filtered samples; levels ±0.85.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any chart symbol/TF; bar-by-bar IIR replay of full series; Part 2 EA deferred.
why_new_for_mis: Turns oscillator failure-in-trend into an explicit cycle-versus-trend regime sensor MIS can gate mean-reversion vs trend modules on.
quote: When the market trends, the Even Better Sinewave deliberately rails near +1 or -1 and stays there, and that railing is precisely how you detect that you have left cycle mode and entered trend mode.

mechanism: Roofing Filter cascade: 2-pole high-pass (default hpPeriod 48, removes spectral dilation/slow trend) into Super Smoother (ssPeriod 10, removes HF noise); output near-zero-mean oscillation in ~10–48 bar tradeable band.
data_needed: Stateful SuperSmoother + RoofingFilter classes; median price input; full-series IIR replay each OnCalculate.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol/TF on chart; defaults 48/10 bar periods.
why_new_for_mis: Band-pass price sensor that isolates cycle component for MIS without trend bias or MA ripple — foundation for cycle-period and regime tools in Part 2.
quote: A low-pass filter and a high-pass filter working together to isolate a band is exactly what the Roofing Filter does.... Passes only the tradeable band; output has ~zero mean.

mechanism: Write-through CHashMap + human-readable .kv flat file for EA state across restarts; mentions regime flags as stored payloads but builds no sensor.
why_new_for_mis: Persistence infrastructure; sensing would live in callers that store regime flags.
quote: Regime Detection States: Structural market classification flags—such as trend versus mean-reversion modes, volatility filters, and asset correlation states—are wiped

mechanism: Logical→broker symbol mapping via description heuristics, prefix/suffix strip, hash mapper, resolution cache, HostVerification bid/ask checks; no market regime sensing.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, XAUUSD→GOLD, US30→US30Cash, SP500, NAS100, GER40, UK100, USOIL, UKOIL, BTCUSD, etc.
quote: Deploying the same Expert Advisor across multiple MetaTrader 5 brokers often fails not because of trading logic, but because instrument identifiers differ between terminals.

mechanism: Native MQL5 Kronos tokenizer: per-window z-score on OHLCVA → embed → (n_enc_layers-1) pre-norm transformer blocks (RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, causal MHA) → project to 20-d latent → Binary Spherical Quantization signs → hierarchical s1/s2 10-bit tokens (0–1023); golden-ref exact token match vs PyTorch.
data_needed: Lookback L×6 (open,high,low,close,volume,amount); exported .bin weights; timestamp features with pandas weekday remap; KR_CLIP±5.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Candlestick sequences generally; frozen verification window L=256; predictor/forecast in Part 2.
why_new_for_mis: Discrete hierarchical candle-token sequence sensor runnable inside MT5 without Python — MIS can embed bars as foundation-model tokens for downstream regime/forecast heads.
quote: Kronos turns a sequence of candles into a sequence of discrete tokens drawn from its own learned vocabulary.... BSQ then reduces each bar to a 20-bit code, split into a 10-bit coarse subtoken and a 10-bit fine subtoken

mechanism: CRetryExecutor exponential backoff + CCircuitBreaker CLOSED/OPEN/HALF-OPEN + CExecutionGateway Submit; execution reliability, not market sensing.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Demo on EURUSD Daily; invalid-symbol failure injection.
quote: CCircuitBreaker tracks consecutive failure counts across multiple submission attempts and blocks further submissions after a configurable threshold

mechanism: Flat-object JSON tokenizer → SStrategyConfig (lot, SL/TP, max_spread, magic, comment) with hotkey reload; config plumbing, not a sensor.
why_new_for_mis: External config loader only; m_max_spread_pts is a static threshold field, not adaptive sensing.
quote: An external JSON file moves configuration into a single shared source that any chart's EA instance can re-read on a hotkey press.

mechanism: Recursive EW covariance Cov_ij,t = λ·Cov_ij,t-1 + (1−λ)·r_i,t·r_j,t on log returns; Corr = Cov/√(Var_i Var_j) with near-zero variance guard; min_obs warm-up; live blue-white-red heatmap — detects correlation regime shifts without waiting for fixed-window rolloff.
data_needed: N symbols’ closed-bar log returns MathLog(c_t/c_{t-1}); λ (default 0.94); min_obs (default 30); flat N×N matrix.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, XAUUSD, USDCHF; PERIOD_CURRENT (demo heatmap on EURUSD Daily).
why_new_for_mis: Online multi-asset correlation-regime-change sensor with constant memory — MIS can flag hedge breakdown / risk understatement when correlations shock.
quote: When a correlation regime shifts... the fixed-window matrix can only incorporate new information as fast as old observations roll out.... A shock at bar t immediately influences the very next estimate, weighted by (1 − λ)

mechanism: Scan closed bars for base candle + 1.5× body displacement that closes beyond base high/low (MSS); track unmitigated OB until later bar wick retests zone (bull: low≤OB low; bear: high≥OB high); latest unmitigated zone returned by reference.
data_needed: CopyRates window m_max_zones+5; OHLC; shift≥1; direction ±1; mitigation flag.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart symbol PERIOD_CURRENT; USDJPY M5 example in live note.
why_new_for_mis: Rule-based institutional imbalance / residual-liquidity zone sensor with explicit mitigation lifecycle — MIS structure filter complementary to VWAP/spread sensors.
quote: a module that detects real price imbalance zones: the last opposite candle before the impulse shift that breaks through the nearest structure (MSS), and keeps this zone active until its retest (mitigation).

mechanism: Per-symbol rolling circular-buffer histogram of SYMBOL_SPREAD (default 50 bins, 0–50 pts, 5000-tick window); percentile rank of live spread → GREEN/YELLOW/RED/WARMING; IsOrderAllowed only GREEN|YELLOW; alert hysteresis + cooldown.
data_needed: SymbolInfoInteger SYMBOL_SPREAD per tick; num_bins, min/max pts, window_size; alert_pct 95 / warn_pct 75.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, GBPJPY, USDJPY; tick-level updates; demo panels on EURUSD H1.
why_new_for_mis: Distribution-relative execution-cost / liquidity-stress sensor — MIS can gate entries when spread is anomalous vs that instrument’s own recent law, not a static pip cutoff.
quote: The fix is to compare the live spread not to a constant but to the instrument's own recent distribution.... RED: above the alert threshold — order submission stops
